entities.summary: Edmund Maurice Burke Roche, 4th Baron Fermoy was a British Conservative Party politician and peer in the Peerage of Ireland. He served as Member of Parliament for King's Lynn from 1924 to 1935 and again from 1943 to 1945. Roche was the maternal grandfather of Diana, Princess of Wales, through his daughter Frances Shand Kydd, and the husband of Ruth Roche, Baroness Fermoy, a confidante of Queen Elizabeth The Queen Mother.
